import re

# Ensure submission directory exists

# Text preprocessing function
def preprocess_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text = str(text)
    # Remove surrounding double quotes
    if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"'):
        text = text[1:-1]
    # Decode unicode escapes
    try:
        text = text.encode("utf-8").decode("unicode_escape")
    except:
        pass
    # Remove special characters but keep basic punctuation
    text = re.sub(r"[^\w\s!?.,]", " ", text)
    return text.lower()

# Text feature extraction function with insult keyword and sentiment features
def extract_text_features(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        text = ""
    else:
        text = str(text)

    # Remove surrounding quotes for feature extraction
    if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"'):
        text = text[1:-1]

    features = {}
    features["length"] = len(text)
    features["word_count"] = len(text.split())
    features["exclamation_count"] = text.count("!")
    features["question_count"] = text.count("?")
    features["uppercase_ratio"] = sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper()) / max(
        len(text), 1
    )
    features["digit_count"] = sum(1 for c in text if c.isdigit())
    features["space_ratio"] = text.count(" ") / max(len(text), 1)

    # Word-level all-caps ratio (words that are entirely uppercase)
    words = text.split()
    if len(words) > 0:
        all_caps_words = sum(1 for w in words if w.isupper() and len(w) > 1)
        features["all_caps_word_ratio"] = all_caps_words / len(words)
    else:
        features["all_caps_word_ratio"] = 0

    # Count of ALL CAPS words with length >= 3 (filter out short common words)
    # This better captures aggressive shouting patterns
    if len(words) > 0:
        long_all_caps_words = sum(1 for w in words if w.isupper() and len(w) >= 3)
        features["long_all_caps_word_count"] = long_all_caps_words
        features["long_all_caps_word_ratio"] = long_all_caps_words / len(words)
    else:
        features["long_all_caps_word_count"] = 0
        features["long_all_caps_word_ratio"] = 0

    # Aggressive punctuation patterns (consecutive exclamation or question marks)
    exclamation_patterns = len(re.findall(r"!{2,}", text))
    question_patterns = len(re.findall(r"\?{2,}", text))
    features["aggressive_punctuation_count"] = exclamation_patterns + question_patterns

    # Ratio of aggressive punctuation to total punctuation
    total_punctuation = text.count("!") + text.count("?")
    features["aggressive_punctuation_ratio"] = features[
        "aggressive_punctuation_count"
    ] / max(total_punctuation, 1)

    # Average word length
    if len(words) > 0:
        avg_word_length = sum(len(w) for w in words) / len(words)
        features["avg_word_length"] = avg_word_length
    else:
        features["avg_word_length"] = 0

    # Count of insult keywords in text
    text_lower = text.lower()
    insult_keyword_count = 0
    for keyword in INSULT_KEYWORDS:
        pattern = r"\b" + re.escape(keyword) + r"\b"
        insult_keyword_count += len(re.findall(pattern, text_lower))
    features["insult_keyword_count"] = insult_keyword_count

    # Ratio of insult keywords to word count
    if len(words) > 0:
        features["insult_keyword_ratio"] = insult_keyword_count / len(words)
    else:
        features["insult_keyword_ratio"] = 0

    # Count of negative sentiment words in text
    negative_sentiment_count = 0
    for word in NEGATIVE_SENTIMENT_WORDS:
        pattern = r"\b" + re.escape(word) + r"\b"
        negative_sentiment_count += len(re.findall(pattern, text_lower))
    features["negative_sentiment_count"] = negative_sentiment_count

    # Ratio of negative sentiment words to word count
    if len(words) > 0:
        features["negative_sentiment_ratio"] = negative_sentiment_count / len(words)
    else:
        features["negative_sentiment_ratio"] = 0

    # NEW FEATURE: Count of intensifier words that amplify negative sentiment
    # This captures linguistic patterns where intensifiers strengthen aggressive tone
    intensifier_count = 0
    for word in INTENSIFIER_WORDS:
        pattern = r"\b" + re.escape(word) + r"\b"
        intensifier_count += len(re.findall(pattern, text_lower))
    features["intensifier_count"] = intensifier_count

    # Ratio of intensifier words to total word count
    if len(words) > 0:
        features["intensifier_ratio"] = intensifier_count / len(words)
    else:
        features["intensifier_ratio"] = 0

    # Count of words with 3+ consecutive vowels (emotional intensity)
    vowel_pattern = r"[aeiou]{3,}"
    words_with_vowel_emphasis = len(re.findall(vowel_pattern, text_lower))
    features["vowel_emphasis_count"] = words_with_vowel_emphasis

    # Ratio of vowel emphasis words to total word count
    if len(words) > 0:
        features["vowel_emphasis_ratio"] = words_with_vowel_emphasis / len(words)
    else:
        features["vowel_emphasis_ratio"] = 0

    return features

train_df["Comment_clean"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(preprocess_text)
test_df["Comment_clean"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(preprocess_text)

train_features = train_df["Comment"].apply(extract_text_features).apply(pd.Series)
test_features = test_df["Comment"].apply(extract_text_features).apply(pd.Series)

# Create TF-IDF features with word n-grams
tfidf_word = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2), analyzer="word", max_features=20000, min_df=2, max_df=0.95
)

# Create TF-IDF features with character n-grams
tfidf_char = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(3, 5), analyzer="char", max_features=10000, min_df=2, max_df=0.95
)

# Fit and transform word features on training data
X_train_word = tfidf_word.fit_transform(train_df["Comment_clean"])
X_test_word = tfidf_word.transform(test_df["Comment_clean"])

# Fit and transform character features on training data
X_train_char = tfidf_char.fit_transform(train_df["Comment_clean"])
X_test_char = tfidf_char.transform(test_df["Comment_clean"])

# Convert text features to sparse matrices
X_train_text = csr_matrix(train_features.values)
X_test_text = csr_matrix(test_features.values)

# Combine features
X_train_combined = hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char, X_train_text])
X_test_combined = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char, X_test_text])

y_train = train_df["Insult"].values

# Create explicit train/validation split for genuine hold-out validation
X_train_split, X_val_split, y_train_split, y_val_split = train_test_split(
    X_train_combined, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

print(f"Training set size: {X_train_split.shape[0]}")
print(f"Validation set size: {X_val_split.shape[0]}")

# Train model on training split only
model = LogisticRegression(random_state=42, max_iter=1000, C=1.0, solver="lbfgs")
model.fit(X_train_split, y_train_split)

# Predict on validation set (genuine hold-out)
val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val_split)[:, 1]

# Calculate AUC-ROC on validation set
auc_score = roc_auc_score(y_val_split, val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {auc_score}")

# Train final model on ALL training data for submission
final_model = LogisticRegression(random_state=42, max_iter=1000, C=1.0, solver="lbfgs")
final_model.fit(X_train_combined, y_train)

# Predict on test data
test_pred = final_model.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]

# Create submission file with correct format using ORIGINAL comments and dates
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Comment": test_original_comments,
        "Date": test_original_dates,
        "Insult": test_pred,
    }
)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(
    f"Submission Insult range: [{submission['Insult'].min()}, {submission['Insult'].max()}]"
)
